referral.name: Hargreaves A
referral.reason_text: Raised ALT and ALP, now progressive dysphagia to solids and weight loss.

deciding.fast_track_met: Progressive dysphagia is documented in clinical.symptoms and the reason text, which meets the dysphagia criterion outright.
deciding.vetting_outcome: The LFTs are about six months old and the main question is liver. That supports return with advice, but progressive dysphagia with weight loss supports expediting.
deciding.first_contact: The stale LFTs could be handled with written advice. Dysphagia with weight loss could instead need a face-to-face consultant visit, so the two are close.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Progressive dysphagia is a red flag with no explaining result, and the stale bloods do not show an acute abnormality. This points to urgent rather than very urgent.
deciding.record_agreement: The only difference is the surname spelling, Hargreaves versus Hargreave. The age and date of birth agree.
